thread:
marie: Quick check — about to merge the change to enforce mTLS between router and serving. Wanted a fast thumbs-up on cipher list + log redaction before we flip the flag.
ishaan: looking now. Are we keeping TLS1.2 as a fallback? I know some older infra still negotiates it.
marie: plan was TLS1.3 primary, TLS1.2 allowed for older internal agents but with a restricted cipher list. here's the snippet from the helm values: 
```yaml
server.tls.minVersion: TLS1.2
server.tls.preferred: TLS1.3
server.tls.cipherSuites:
  - TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
  - TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
  - ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
```
sam: that ECDHE-ECDSA one is only for legacy hosts with ecdsa certs — ok. confirm we drop RC4/3DES etc. :+1:
ishaan: agree. couple notes:
- ensure session IDs and client IPs are redacted in serving logs (we should only keep anon session hashes).
- confirm KMS key owner for the serving TLS certs — who can rotate?
marie: good call. logs: we already have a logging filter: `redact_fields: [session_id, client_ip]` in the config. I opened a quick PR to add a test for that. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/842
marie: KMS: currently labeled `projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/tls-serving-v1`. Owner is the infra-kms group (iam: infra-kms@redwood.com). Rotation is automatic every 90 days but manual rotation needs infra-kms approval.
ishaan: I need temporary access to trigger an emergency rotation for a customer key if needed — can infra-kms grant me `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` scoped to that key?
sam: from ops side: we prefer to keep rotations through infra runbook unless it's an emergency. If ops approves, we can open a one-time access with an expiry via the access portal. Please file a request in #help with the key path and reason.
marie: filed internal ticket already: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2769 (grant ish rotation for incident simulation). But for this change to go live we don't need manual rotation — just want the owner list in docs.
security-bot: reminder — TLS certificate private key material must not be logged or sent to third-party services. Confirmed check: CI static-scan flagged no private key files in repo.
ishaan: noted. also suggest we add a smoke test after deploy to verify mTLS handshake from a staging client: `openssl s_client -connect router:443 -cert client.pem -key client.key -tls1_3` — will add to the deploy job.
marie: that'd be great. can you add the smoke test to `deploy/staging/steps.yaml` and ping me?
ishaan: on it, will open a tiny PR.
ops-bot: deploy queued for `canary/staging` (job 4621). Will run smoke tests post-deploy.
marie: thanks — if no objections by EOD I'll merge and flip the flag tomorrow morning.
sam: no objections from infra. one ask: add a short note in the runbook about whom to call for KMS emergency rotations (pager + slack).
marie: will update runbook and add emergency contact.
ishaan: ack. thanks all :thumbsup:
